reference.heading: Reference card
reference.method_line: Ask clearly, know what you need, turn it into rules, score the result, improve, keep a record.
loop_lines: In this course your prompt gives an answer, the answer is saved to a file, your checker reads the file, and the checker gives a result.

verdicts.name: PASS
verdicts.meaning: The checker found what the rule asks for.

verdicts.name: FAIL
verdicts.meaning: The checker found the rule was not met.

verdicts.name: NOT CHECKED
verdicts.meaning: The rule needs human judgment, so the checker cannot decide it. It is not covered until you rewrite it.

principles: Never edit the checker to make a failing answer pass, because a failing result is the information.
Never hide a rule that could not be checked. It stays NOT CHECKED, so you can see what is not covered.
Write your predictions before you run the checker, so the result can surprise you.
